还有谁不服？


Ashok Elluswamy (@aelluswamy)

We are launching the Tesla Robotaxi safety report today.  

Till date, Robotaxi has driven a total of 3.3 million miles autonomously, and has had zero injuries nor airbag deployments. If the same number of miles were to be manually driven, we should expect roughly 9 injuries to the occupants or other pedestrians and 4 airbag deployments on average.

We will continue to transparently share our progress with the public using this page.
tesla.com/robotaxi/safety

Link



Robotaxi Safety Report | Tesla

Our Robotaxi fleet is designed to make roads safer for riders, drivers and pedestrians alike.
tesla.com




— http://nitter.meowing.monster/aelluswamy/status/2112981960880783781#m
tweets.text_zh:
还有谁不服？


阿肖克·埃勒斯瓦米 (@aelluswamy)

我们今天发布特斯拉机器人出租车安全报告。  

迄今为止，Robotaxi 已自动行驶了总计 330 万英里，并且零伤害，也没有安全气囊部署。如果手动驾驶相同的英里数，我们预计乘员或其他行人平均会受到大约 9 次伤害，并且平均会展开 4 个安全气囊。

我们将继续使用此页面与公众透明地分享我们的进展。
tesla.com/robotaxi/safety

有几个发音听懂特别重要

其他所有小朋友不管输赢
都是开开心心的休息

毫无意外的，他们后面两场全输了
我们全赢了，小组第一
